summary: No material errors were found in any answer. Both arms correctly diagnose favorable aesthetic reception, unresolved environmental claims, and initially isolated arrival leakage. Both updates correctly strengthen arrival-leak support to seven visible accounts within one thread, distinguish two explicit loose-top reports from four bare agreements, and retain zero-like evidence. All requested counts and source sets are correct. Remedies remain a conditional brand offer versus a customer-reported replacement sent, without confirmed delivery. Softwear–Void’s pocket leakage, proposed closure changes, and repurchase intention despite dissatisfaction remain separate from the unidentified TikTok product and arrival conditions. Buying enthusiasm, trial/reuse intentions, receipt, and brand loyalty are appropriately distinguished from completed purchases and packaging-driven behavior. Engagement is not converted into independent experiences, and missing retailer engagement remains unavailable. The incremental update explicitly flags unresolved cross-venue actor overlap; the full update emphasizes product and use-condition limits. Neither difference materially changes the diagnosis. These answers establish no causal advantage for either arm.
